（印：MISCELLANEOUS FILES No. 38127 Date June 3 1937）
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S.B.D. 7581
7581
REPORT
H. C. C. B. Station, 37
Date June 3, 1937.
Subject FORGED CZECHO - SLOVAKIAN PASSPORT.
Made by D.S.I. Bebenin Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
To conclude this file, I beg to report that
following information, which forms the subject of this case,
D.S.I. Bebenin and D.S. Kourjansky obtained the services of
informer Kanaeff, and through his assistance arrested on
21.4.37 one named E. I. Lukianchenko, residing at House 26,
Lane 47, Chengtu Road. The search of the above address resulted
in the seizure by the Police of one Czecho - Slovakian and one
Persian forged passports. Paraphernalia which had been used
in the forging of the passports was also found.
E. I. Lukianchenko was charged accordingly, and
having been found guilty of the charges preferred against him,
he was sentenced to 4 months' imprisonment on 8.5.37.
All papers relating to the arrest of E. I.
Lukianchenko are attached to Chengtu Road F.I.R 307/37.
The sample impression of the genuine Persian
Consular seal which had been obtained from the Local Persian
Consulate in March, 1937, (see D.S.I. Bebenin's report of
22.3.37) was produced to the Court as evidence, and it is now
attached to the Court's file, in connection with the case papers
No. 7/93856.
Please note that since the Local Iranian Consulate
was closed, the interests of the Iranian citizens at Shanghai
are unofficially represented by Mr. H. Touty of the H.M.H.
Vicazee & Co., 190 Peking Road, Shanghai.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
（签名）Prince
S.I S.I.
D.S.I. V. I. Bebenin.

（印：杂项档案 第38127号 日期 1937年6月3日）
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 S.B.D. 7581
7581
报告
虹口捕房，37号
日期 1937年6月3日。
事由 伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照。
由侦探副督察贝别宁（Bebenin）呈报，经首席侦探督察普林斯（Prince）转呈。

先生：
为结案起见，谨报告构成本案主题的下列情况：
侦探副督察贝别宁（Bebenin）和侦探库良斯基（Kourjansky）利用了线人卡纳耶夫（Kanaeff）的服务，并在其协助下于1937年4月21日逮捕了一名居住在成都路47弄26号的名为 E. I. 卢基扬琴科（E. I. Lukianchenko）的男子。对上述地址的搜查导致警方查获一本伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照和一本伪造的波斯护照。还发现了用于伪造护照的工具。
E. I. 卢基扬琴科因此被起诉，并于1937年5月8日被判犯有针对他的指控罪名成立，判处监禁4个月。
所有与逮捕 E. I. 卢基扬琴科有关的文件均附在成都路警局首次调查报告（F.I.R）307/37号之后。
1937年3月从本地波斯领事馆获得的真实波斯领事印章样本（见侦探副督察贝别宁1937年3月22日的报告）已作为证据提交法庭，现随案件卷宗第7/93856号附在法庭档案中。
请注意，由于本地伊朗领事馆已关闭，伊朗公民在上海的利益由上海北京路190号 H.M.H. Vicazee & Co. 公司的 H. Touty 先生非正式代表。

此致，
敬礼，
（签名）普林斯
高级督察
侦探副督察 V. I. 贝别宁。

No 38/37
Date March 22 1937

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. s.b. D.7581
758
H. Q. C. B. Station,
REPORT
Date March 22, 1937

Subject Forged Czecho-Slovakian Passport.

Made by D.S.I. Bebenin Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince

Sir,
With reference to D. C. Crime's remark on the previous
report of 4-2-37, I beg to state that when the sample of the
forged Persian Passport had been first obtained, it was shown
to the Local Iranian Consulate by D.S. Kourjansky. The
secretary of the Consulate declared the passport to be forged
and stated that in the event of arrests made a Consular
representative would be sent to Court to act as a complaining
witness for the prosecution.

In view of the fact that the Iranian Consulate at
Shanghai and the Iranian Ministry in Nanking will be closed
some time at end of this month, and with the exception of
Tokyo there will be no Iranian representatives in the Far East.
D.S.I. Bebenin paid a visit to the local Iranian Consulate and
obtained from its secretary a specimen (attached) of the
Iranian Government's seal which is used to stamp all Persian
Passports. This may at some later date help the Police to
distinguish the genuine Persian Passports from the forged ones.

The secretary also drew the attention of D.S.I.
Bebenin the fact that the forged passport which he saw, had a
blank space left for the "No. General" of the Passport, whereas
the genuine passports have this number printed. Furthermore,
he stated that "Nos. Generals" of all Iranian Passports issued
in China are numbered from 45000 to 46000, and the passports
issued in Japan from 46000 to 47000.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 23 MAR 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
（批：26/2 273）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 23 MAR 1937 CRIME BRANCH）

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
C.D.I. Prince
C.T. 28/3.
V.V. Bebenin
D.S.I.

D.C.(Crime)

中央法医研究所翻译档案
G. 45M-1-6
第38/37号
日期 1937年3月22日

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 s.b. D.7581
758
总部罪案处，
报告
日期 1937年3月22日

事由 伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照。

由侦探副督察贝别宁呈报，经首席侦探督察普林斯转呈

先生：
关于副警务总监（罪案）在1937年2月4日上一份报告上的批示，谨陈述如下：当首次获得伪造的波斯护照样本时，侦探库良斯基将其出示给本地伊朗领事馆。领事馆秘书声明该护照系伪造，并表示如果实施逮捕，将派遣一名领事代表出庭，作为控方的控告证人。

鉴于上海伊朗领事馆和南京伊朗公使馆将于本月底某个时候关闭，且除东京外，远东地区将没有伊朗代表。侦探副督察贝别宁拜访了本地伊朗领事馆，并从其秘书处获得了伊朗政府用于在所有波斯护照上盖章的印章样本（见附件）。这可能有助于警方在日后区分真实的波斯护照和伪造的护照。

秘书还提请侦探副督察贝别宁注意这样一个事实：他所看到的伪造护照在“总编号”（No. General）一栏留有空白，而真实护照则印有该号码。此外，他表示，在中国签发的所有伊朗护照的“总编号”从45000到46000编号，而在日本签发的护照从46000到47000编号。

（印：特别处 1937年3月23日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
（批：26/2 273）
（印：副警务总监 1937年3月23日 罪案处）

此致，
敬礼，
首席侦探督察 普林斯
C.T. 3月28日。
V.V. 贝别宁
侦探副督察。

副警务总监（罪案）

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.S.6, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. D. 7581
Date February 4, 1937.

Subject "Forged Czecho-Slovakian passport".

Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to my report of October 29, 1936, File
No. D. 7581, I have to state that Ivan GRIGORIEFF, following his
attempt to dispose of the false Czecho-Slovakian passport, has
not been seen again in Shanghai and no information can be obta-
ined as to his present whereabouts.

However, further information has been received that
two other persons are connected with the traffic in forged
passports, namely:- Efrem J. LUKIANCHENKO, Russian, born 1903,
C.R.O. F-23, forger and burglar, and Boris A. KANAEFF, Russian,
born 1906, C.R.O. F-21, thief and forger, both residing at
House No. 26 Q, Lane 47, Chengtu Road.

D.S.I. Bebenin, attached to C. 1, engaged another
informer, who contacted the two criminals and succeeded in
obtaining one of their forged Persian passports under the
pretext of showing it to a buyer, which was immediately photo-
graphed (copy attached); they also deal in Czecho-Slovakian
passports.

The two criminals named last above suddenly ceased
negotiations with the informer. Careful enquiries lead to the
belief that LUKIANCHENKO and KANAEFF have somehow discovered
that our informer was working for the Police.

LUKIANCHENKO and KANAEFF will be kept under surveillance,
in the meantime I respectfully suggest that this case be filed.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
C.S.6，特别处。
报告
档案编号 D. 7581
日期 1937年2月4日。

事由 “伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照”。

由侦探库良斯基呈报。由 [签名] 转呈。

关于我1936年10月29日关于档案编号 D. 7581 的报告，须说明的是，伊万·格里戈里耶夫（Ivan GRIGORIEFF）在试图处理那本伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照后，未再在上海露面，也无法获得关于他目前下落的信息。

然而，收到进一步消息，另有两人参与伪造护照的交易，即：- 叶夫列姆·J·卢基扬琴科（Efrem J. LUKIANCHENKO），俄国人，生于1903年，刑事记录办公室档案 F-23，伪造者和窃贼；以及鲍里斯·A·卡纳耶夫（Boris A. KANAEFF），俄国人，生于1906年，刑事记录办公室档案 F-21，小偷和伪造者，两人均居住在成都路47弄26号Q室。

隶属于 C. 1 组的侦探副督察贝别宁启用了另一名线人，该线人接触了这两名罪犯，并以向买家展示为借口，成功获得了他们的一本伪造波斯护照，并立即进行了拍照（副本附件）；他们还交易捷克斯洛伐克护照。

上述最后提到的两名罪犯突然停止了与线人的谈判。经过仔细查询，使人相信卢基扬琴科和卡纳耶夫以某种方式发现我们的线人是在为警方工作。

卢基扬琴科和卡纳耶夫将受到监视，同时我恭敬地建议将此案归档。

（左侧手写批注：）
C1.
伊朗当局
并已通知
奥地利人
5/7 副本

副警务总监 罪案处
[签名] D. S. 库良斯基

REPORT
Date Nov 6 , 36.

Subject Further to "Forged Czechoslovakian Passport".

Made by D. S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by C. L. Jones D. S.

With reference to my report of October 29, 1936, on the
subject of "Forged Czechoslovakian Passport", I have to state
that the owner of the described passport is known to my informant
under the name of Ivan GRIGORIEFF, Russian, aged about 35, chestnut
hair, oval face, has a small moustache, medium build, height about
5' 8", wears gold ring on one of the left hand fingers, usually
walks without a hat.

No information could as yet be obtained as to the address
of GRIGORIEFF who suddenly terminated negotiations with the
informant, stating that he will be away for a while and that he
will contact him again in the near future.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH 7）
D. C. Special Branch.

C.S.C, Special Branch. xxxxx 7.81
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
Date Oct. 29, 1936.
Subject Forged Czecho-Slovakian Passport.
Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by Em Goldac O.I.

I forward herewith photographs of a forged Czecho-Slovakia
passport, which was obtained from an informer to-day, October
29, 1936.

The fact that it is a forgery was confirmed as the result
of a visit to the Czecho-Slovakian Consulate this morning.

The informant who wishes to remain anonymous at present,
has indicated to me that a certain amount of traffic in forged
passports of the country mentioned is being practised and that
the possible point of emanation is Tientsin, whilst the
persons engaged in the manufacture of these documents are
allegedly headed by a Russian known to him as IVANOFF.

The informant stated that the owner of the above passport,
a Russian, intended to dispose of same, and that he succeeded
in obtaining temporary custody of the document under the
pretext of finding a buyer.

In view of the above, I respectfully request that action
in this case be deferred for one or two days to enable me to
establish more definitely the identity of the above Russian.

D. S. Kourjansky
D. S.

D. C. Special Branch.

（左侧批注：Further x Source of supply）

机密报告
日期 1936年10月29日。
事由 伪造的捷克斯洛伐克护照。
由 D.S. 库良斯基呈报。由 Em Goldac O.I. 转呈。

兹附上今日（1936年10月29日）从线人处获得的一本伪造捷克斯洛伐克护照的照片。

今早访问捷克斯洛伐克领事馆后，确认其为伪造品。

目前希望保持匿名的线人向我指出，存在一定数量的上述国家伪造护照的交易活动，可能的来源地是天津，而从事这些文件制造的人员据称由一名他称为 IVANOFF 的俄国人领导。

线人称，上述护照的所有人是一名俄国人，打算处理该护照，而他以寻找买家为借口，成功暂时保管了该文件。

鉴于上述情况，我恭敬地请求将此案的行动推迟一两天，以便我更确切地查明上述俄国人的身份。

D. S. 库良斯基
侦探

副警务总监 特别处。

（左侧批注：进一步 x 供应来源）
